speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Is that Shakespeare? Hunsdon. From Somerset House. Speak up, man, I've a fire roaring here like a Scot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord. Your lordship's servant. We are this moment come off the stage.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: What was it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard the Third, my lord.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: The crookback. Good. He's dead and nobody minds him. Now hear me, for I've no breath to say it twice. Christmas. The court keeps it at Richmond. You are sent for. Three nights. St Stephen's, St John's, Innocents'.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three, my lord. We are much bound to your lordship.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: You're bound to be good, that's what you're bound to. She was merry at Greenwich last year. I'd have her merry again. What have you that's new?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The comedy of the King of Navarre, my lord, that Her Majesty has not seen. And a tragedy of two lovers, that will be ready before Advent.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Lovers. Do they die?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They do, my lord.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Hm. Well, she likes a death if it's young and it's Italian. Is there bawdy in it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a Nurse, my lord.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Ha! Then there's bawdy. Good. Bring the lovers. Bring the Navarre thing. And the third night something old, something they can laugh at with a cup in their hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the other king, my lord? Richard the Second draws the town.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: God's wounds, no. Are you mad? There's a book come out of Antwerp about who shall wear the crown after, with my lord of Essex's name on the front of it, and the Queen has had him by the ears for it this very week. I'll not carry a play to court where a king is talked out of his chair. Not this winter. Not in that house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I understand your lordship.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: See you do. Play it in Shoreditch till the boards wear through, and the Master has cut it. I've no quarrel with it. I saw it, did they tell you? I stood at the back like a carter. Your Burbage made me weep, the villain. But there's a time for a thing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord, one matter more. Sir Thomas Heneage being dead, God rest him, my fellow Heminges would know, who signs for the players now?

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Ha. Your grocer would know who pays. A pox on it, so would I. The office is not filled. You'll be paid. You'll be paid slow. You were paid slow when he was alive. Tell your grocer the Queen's debt is better than another man's coin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll tell him so, my lord. He'll write it in his book and look at it.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Ha! Let him. Kettleby will send you the days and the hours. And Shakespeare. Clean hose. All of you. Last year one of your fellows had a hole in his heel a man could have put a fist through, and I saw her see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It shall be mended, my lord.

speaker: henry_carey_hunsdon
text: Mend it. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And your good lordship.
